text: What confidence did you have to have?
And how did you get that confidence to not only participate in your sport,
but then to thrive so successfully?
Our confidence always wavers, particularly when the pressure's on.
Sometimes for me, it's about not waiting for the confidence
to set in before just giving something a crack.
Sport puts you out of your comfort zone.
And you need to find the confidence within you to step into that space and thrive.
